title: Produce the July time-to-decision SLA scorecard
description: Leadership reviews the ops scorecard weekly and the July period is now closed. Produce the time-to-decision SLA attainment scorecard for July from the metric config (metrics/sla_attainment_july) and the case ledger, and save it to reports/scorecard_july_ttd.md. Compute per the standard methodology in Ops Handbook 6.2. Note: the July extract was loaded through the nightly case export while the loader was having commit-confirmation timeouts (see metrics/case_ledger_july_load_journal.json); check the extract against the load journal before computing and correct any genuine data-quality errors per Ops Handbook 6.2.
